description: Which rule-set editions are field-identical for which jurisdictions. Verified by netpay-core test 18 (jurisdiction tables) and ingest test 19 (claim-code files). A PDOC cache record with observed_edition A may satisfy a case keyed to rule_set_version B only when A==B or every jurisdiction the case touches is listed under identical_jurisdictions and its claim-code table under identical_claim_code_tables.
